text:
BOS and STL both come in off losses two days ago. The Bruins fell 2-1 at CAR but are 3-1-1 in their last five, outscoring opponents 19-10. The Blues were shut out 2-0 at home by MTL, where Jacob Fowler stopped all 46 shots, and are 2-3-0 in their last five. STL plays without Ross Johnston and Dillon Dube in game five of a five-game home stand. It's the first meeting of the season, and BOS won both games last year.

The chances are close. BOS has taken 53% of the expected goals (the quality of shots) at five on five, STL 50%, and our model has it 2.92 to 2.86. But BOS's results run ahead of its chances: it has finished 7.5 more goals than its shots usually produce, and its goaltending has saved 13.1 more than expected. BOS has taken 4.7 penalties a game, and its power play and STL's penalty kill are the matchup to watch. Projected starters Jeremy Swayman (BOS) and Joel Hofer (STL) are at +8.1 and +3.2 goals saved above expected this season. Swayman was at +26.5 last season, Hofer at +11.1.

David Pastrnak has a 30% chance to score and 74% to record a point, though we flag him as due to cool. Matthew Poitras has 7 points in his last ten, and the chances behind it look earned. For STL, Dylan Holloway is our model's pick at 25% to score. Pius Suter sits one assist from 100 career assists.
